channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Vitória mostra eficiência e elimina Flamengo da Copa do Brasil
item.description: EC Vitória defeated Flamengo and advanced in the 2026 Copa do Brasil, employing a solid defensive strategy and capitalizing on quick counterattacks. Despite having less ball possession, the team coached by Portuguese tactician Leonardo Jardim maintained tactical discipline, neutralizing Flamengo’s attacks and securing progression through efficiency and organization.

item.title: Candidatura de Flávio resiste ao primeiro teste?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro offered three contradictory explanations in under 24 hours for requesting R$134 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is under investigation for alleged fraud at Banco Master. The conversations, marked by subservient and familiar tone, raise serious concerns about influence peddling and potential corruption. The incident intensifies scrutiny on Flávio’s 2026 electoral candidacy.

item.title: Frias diz que filme de Bolsonaro teve “orçamento menor que o planejado”
item.description: Deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) claims the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, was produced with a budget lower than planned, financed mainly in 2024. According to Intercept Brasil, Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master and currently imprisoned, transferred R$ 61 million between February and May 2025, with the remainder demanded by Flávio Bolsonaro one day before Vorcaro's arrest. Frias denies illegality and suggests the disclosure is politically motivated to weaken the government.

item.title: A rede criminosa de Vorcaro e o dinheiro para o filme sobre Bolsonaro - O Assunto #1720
item.description: Federal Police arrested Henrique Moura Vorcaro, father of Daniel Vorcaro and owner of Banco Master, in the sixth phase of Operation Compliance Zero for running a criminal structure involved in illegal surveillance and intimidation, with infiltration within the PF itself and ties to the Rio de Janeiro bicho game and militias. The PF is also investigating whether funds used to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, were diverted to cover the expenses of Eduardo Bolsonaro in the United States, where he has lived for over a year.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro, o candidato Ypê
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly requested funds from Daniel Vorcaro, a banker implicated in financial fraud and political corruption, to finance a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. The audio revelation exposes a serious scandal involving illicit influence and the use of illegally obtained resources in public affairs. If substantiated, this episode could severely damage any future political aspirations of Flávio Bolsonaro due to the gravity of allegations involving active corruption and influence peddling.

item.title: Fundo para filme, instituto e migração: advogado radicado nos EUA vira elo de dinheiro de Vorcaro com Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Paulo Calixto, a U.S.-based immigration lawyer, serves as an intermediary between banker Daniel Vorcaro and Eduardo Bolsonaro, channeling funds from the Havengate Development Fund LP to finance the biopic 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. Federal Police are investigating whether these funds supported Eduardo Bolsonaro’s stay in the U.S., while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro pressures Vorcaro to send pending payments. Despite lacking financial or cinematic background, Calixto advises Eduardo on U.S. political and legal matters and represents the Instituto Liberdade, tied to Eduardo’s allies and the January 8 riots.

item.title: Pego na mentira, Flávio acusa golpe ao dizer que não desiste de candidatura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for president from the PL party, was accused of requesting R$ 134 million from businessman Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The request came after revelations that Vorcaro is involved in Brazil’s largest banking fraud scandal. Flávio denied withdrawing his candidacy and accused his critics of staging a coup.

item.title: Lula muda regras de subvenção dos combustíveis para assegurar desconto
item.description: President Lula’s government issued decree nº 12.974, tightening oversight of federal fuel subsidies for diesel and cooking gas, requiring distributors, producers, and importers to prove full pass-through of discounts to retailers and consumers via ANP reporting and fiscal documentation. The measure aims to ensure subsidies reach end-users amid rising international oil prices linked to the Middle East conflict. It follows a provisional measure introducing a new gasoline subsidy and expanding existing diesel support mechanisms.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aposta em CPI do Master contra desgaste, mas aliados veem chances mínimas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, plans to leverage his defense of the Banco Master CPI as a strategy to mitigate political damage from revelations that he referred to former banker Daniel Vorcaro as 'my brother' and allocated R$134 million to finance a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. However, allies consider the initiative's chances of success minimal, given the severity of the allegations and public perception of conflict of interest.

item.title: Flávio: É falsa insinuação de que recursos de Vorcaro foram para Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) denied that funds from the Vorcaro project were directed to his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, stating his involvement in the film about Jair Bolsonaro was limited to seeking private investment. He rejected allegations of fund transfers as false.

item.title: Economia ainda é importante para a avaliação do governo?
item.description: The article by Laura Carvalho and Guilherme Klein questions why Lula 3's government approval is only middling despite favorable economic and social indicators. They suggest that non-economic factors — such as management perception, communication, and public expectations — may be shaping opinion. The analysis emphasizes that while the economy matters, it alone is insufficient to secure high government approval.

item.title: Caiado evita criticar Flávio Bolsonaro em entrevista
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado avoided criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro in an interview on Arena Oeste, stating he remains calm due to his 'immaculate' image and arguing that anyone denounced must account for their actions. He called for right-wing unity to defeat the PT, without directly opposing the Rio de Janeiro senator.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia relata que evitava reclamar do trabalho para não ser estigmatizada: ‘Iam dizer: mulher’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia shared that she avoided complaining about her workload during her career for fear of being dismissed as 'just a woman,' emphasizing that gender prejudice remains a cruel and daily reality. She endorsed the ruling upholding Law 14.611/2023, which mandates salary transparency in companies with over 100 employees to combat gender-based pay disparities for equal work.

item.title: Após divergir de Flávio Bolsonaro, Frias apresenta nova versão sobre patrocínio de Vorcaro a filme: 'Diferença de interpretação'
item.description: Federal deputy Mario Frias revised his earlier statement regarding Daniel Vorcaro's financing of the film Dark Horse, stating that his disagreement with Flávio Bolsonaro stemmed from a 'difference in interpretation' about the formal origin of the investment. He clarified that Vorcaro was never a signatory with Banco Master but with the company 'Entre', and denied any societal ties between the Bolsonaros and the film or its producer. Frias further accused the left and certain right-wing factions of fabricating a 'tacky narrative' to sabotage Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, claiming investors feared persecution.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro nega ter recebido dinheiro de fundo ligado a Vorcaro e diz que status migratório nos EUA 'não permitiria'
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denied receiving money from a fund linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating his U.S. immigration status would prevent such transactions without triggering punishment by American authorities. He said he disclosed the source of his funds during his visa process and faced no issues. The Federal Police are investigating whether Vorcaro’s funds were used to finance the film 'Dark Horse' or to cover Eduardo’s expenses in the U.S., with uncertainties about Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s role in the negotiations.

item.title: Flávio diz que rompeu com Vorcaro após acusações virem a público
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he ended his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, after Vorcaro was accused of leading a criminal organization involved in billion-dollar financial frauds became public. He said his involvement in the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro was limited to seeking private investment, with funds sent to the U.S. and directed to a specific production fund, denying they were used to benefit his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro. Flávio denied any ties to corruption schemes involving the federal government, emphasizing there were no off-agenda meetings, payments to former ministers, or contracts with the Justice Minister.

item.title: Flávio fala em “contaminação política” após entrevista à GloboNews
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) issued an official statement following his GloboNews interview, denying direct involvement in the financial transfers made by banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', a biography of Jair Bolsonaro. He denounced what he called 'political contamination' in media coverage, claiming there is an effort to link him to illicit schemes without evidence. Flávio reiterated that the funds were allocated to the film lawfully and that there is no irregularity in his conduct.

item.title: 🚨 URGENTE! Caiado cobra explicações de Flávio Bolsonaro,mas pede união da direita contra Lula e o PT
item.description: Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado demanded explanations from Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged links to corruption schemes, but stressed the need for unity among right-wing forces to defeat Lula and the PT in the 2026 elections. Despite his criticisms, Caiado signaled that the opposition must overcome internal divisions to build a solid front against the federal government.

item.title: MICHELLE BOLSONARO, ZEMA OU FLÁVIO: QUEM ENFRENTA O LULA?
item.description: The content discusses speculation about who will be Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's main opponent in the 2026 elections, focusing on Michelle Bolsonaro, Zema, or Flávio Bolsonaro as potential opposition candidates. Despite references to videos and YouTube functionalities, the text lacks substantive information about policy proposals, debates, or political positions of the mentioned figures. The analysis remains in the realm of electoral conjecture, without deeper exploration of governance themes or platforms.

item.title: Nova etapa das investigações do Master revelam ligações criminosas de Vorcaro com milícia
item.description: The new phase of Operation Compliance Zero revealed links between businessman Henrique Moura Vorcaro, father of banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, and Rio de Janeiro militias and the animal gambling game. His arrest followed the leak of an audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro demanded money from Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro, sparking political fallout and renewed support for a CPMI to investigate Banco Master. Lulo's allies viewed the episode as an opportunity to recover lost poll points, while the president stated that 'lies have short legs' during a speech in Bahia.

item.title: A reação de Lula ao áudio de Flávio Bolsonaro para Vorcaro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva described the alleged links between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro as a 'police matter', declining to comment during a visit to a fertilizer plant in Bahia. Lula stated he is not a police officer or prosecutor and that the case should be handled by authorities. The audio, revealed by The Intercept, shows Flávio requesting money from Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse', which he claims was private sponsorship. PT leader Pedro Uczai urged Coaf to investigate Flávio's financial movements.

item.title: Flávio diz que omitiu investimento de Vorcaro por “confidencialidade”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he did not previously disclose his contact with Daniel Vorcaro due to a confidentiality clause in the 'Dark Horse' film contract, claiming the investment was made with private funds and no public incentives. He denied that the funds were used to finance his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S., saying they were fully applied to the film project, and said Vorcaro breached the agreement, leading him to seek R$134 million in damages.

item.title: Asessora de Mario Frias trabalhou em 'Dark Horse' e Erika Hilton aciona TCU
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSOL) filed a complaint with the TCU against Mario Frias after revelations that one of his staffers worked on the production of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, while being paid by the Chamber of Deputies. Hilton alleges a potential conflict of interest and misuse of public funds.

item.title: Governo amplia obrigações às distribuidoras para tentar assegurar repasse de subsídios aos combustíveis
item.description: The federal government has expanded obligations for fuel distributors to ensure the pass-through of public subsidies to consumers, particularly for diesel and cooking gas. The new rule requires distributors to report volumes traded, purchase and sale prices to the ANP, strengthening oversight of the fuel distribution chain. A subsidy of up to R$ 0.89 per liter for gasoline will be paid directly to producers and importers via ANP, with an estimated monthly impact of R$ 2.7 billion when combined with the upcoming diesel subsidy.

item.title: Gilmar será relator de ação sobre inelegibilidade de Dallagnol
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes has been appointed as rapporteur of a constitutional complaint filed by federal deputy Zeca Dirceu (PT-PR), challenging a Paraná Electoral Court (TRE-PR) order to remove a post stating that former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol (Novo) is a 'criminal' and ineligible for 8 years. Dirceu argues the ruling constitutes censorship and violates freedom of speech and parliamentary immunity, claiming the statement about Dallagnol’s ineligibility is true. The case is connected to Operation Lava Jato, as Dallagnol was a prosecutor in the Curitiba task force and had his 2022 candidacy registration canceled in 2023, though the TSE did not formally declare him ineligible.

item.title: Flávio confirma dinheiro de Vorcaro, mas nega financiamento a Eduardo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed receiving $10.6 million (R$61 million) from Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', a Hollywood-style biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, denying that the money was used to finance his brother Eduardo in the U.S. He stated the investment was made with expectation of return, not as a donation or favor, and that the relationship ended after Vorcaro breached the confidentiality agreement.

item.title: Vorcaro não estava investindo no filme, mas na relação com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Carlos Andreazza analyzes Flávio Bolsonaro’s video in which the senator asks Daniel Vorcaro for money to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro, emphasizing that Vorcaro was investing in his relationship with the Bolsonaro family, not the film itself. Andreazza highlights contradictions: the production denies receiving the funds, while Flávio claims Vorcaro stopped honoring installment payments, raising questions about where the money went. He concludes that the film ceased to be about Bolsonaro and became about Vorcaro, leaving Flávio without a credible narrative.

item.title: Governo sinaliza possível inconstitucionalidade em lei do RS sobre publicidade de bets
item.description: The Ministry of Finance's Secretariat of Prizes and Bets considered possible unconstitutionality in Rio Grande do Sul's Law nº 16.508/2026, which expands restrictions on betting advertising, arguing only Congress can legislate on the matter to ensure national uniformity. The state government maintains the law remains valid until judicially suspended, while other states advance similar proposals. As of now, 32 bills on betting advertising are under consideration in ten states and the Federal District.

item.title: Un audio revela la cercanía de Flávio Bolsonaro a un banquero preso por un megafraude en Brasil
item.description: An audio leak by Intercept Brasil reveals Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asking banker Daniel Vorcaro — arrested in connection with Brazil’s Máster banking fraud scandal — to fund a biopic about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. In the recording, Bolsonaro speaks to Vorcaro in a familiar, collegial tone, despite previously denying any relationship with him. The day after the audio was released, Vorcaro was detained at an airport while attempting to flee the country.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro disse sobre as acusações contra Ciro Nogueira
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in the Banco Master case, claiming innocence and stating the case is tied to the PT, not him. He was confronted by journalist Julia Duailibi regarding the alleged involvement of Ciro Nogueira, PP president and potential Bolsonaro-aligned vice-presidential candidate, with Daniel Vorcaro, a central figure in the Banco Master scandal. The report is exclusive to GloboNews Plus subscribers.

item.title: Caso Vorcaro-Flávio Bolsonaro põe Michelle no céu e Tarcísio no inferno
item.description: The revelation that Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated R$134 million with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro’s life or support an alleged conspiracy by Eduardo Bolsonaro involving U.S. tariffs against Brazil, has caused divisions within the Bolsonarist base, with some laughing and others criticizing the episode.

item.title: Eduardo e Carlos Bolsonaro atacam Zema para defender Flávio de críticas sobre áudio com Vorcaro
item.description: Carlos and Eduardo Bolsonaro attacked Romeu Zema after he criticized Flávio Bolsonaro over an audio in which the senator asked Daniel Vorcaro for funds to finance a film about their father. The Bolsonaro sons defended their brother on social media, calling Zema's criticism unjustified and politically motivated.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Não dá para você querer trazer a preço de agora o contexto do final de 2024
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential pre-candidate and senator, stated in a GloboNews interview that it is not possible to impose the reality of late 2024 onto the present context, emphasizing the need to assess events based on current circumstances. Regarding his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro in 2025, he said Vorcaro was an accused individual and that he hoped Vorcaro would clarify any wrongdoing he may have committed.

item.title: Líder do PT pede que Coaf investigue Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PT congressional leader Pedro Uczai urged the Coaf to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro after reports revealed he demanded delayed payments from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro. Uczai claims the 61 million reais transferred by Vorcaro may have been used to support Eduardo Bolsonaro’s life in the U.S. and finance criminal activities abroad, suggesting possible money laundering and foreign exchange evasion.

item.title: Mario Frias articulou encontro entre Jair Bolsonaro e Vorcaro, diz ‘Intercept’
item.description: Federal deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) arranged a meeting in March 2025 between Jair Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to screen a documentary about the former president. Messages obtained by The Intercept show Frias asked Thiago Miranda of Leo Dias Portal to facilitate the contact, and that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was aware of the meeting, which took place one day after Bolsonaro became a defendant in the STF over the 2022 coup attempt.

item.title: Vorcaro aceitou receber Bolsonaro para exibição de documentário
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro received former President Jair Bolsonaro at his Brasília mansion in late March 2023 to watch a documentary together. The meeting was part of an effort to secure financial support from Vorcaro for Bolsonaro, according to The Intercept Brasil.

item.title: Flávio admite fundo ligado a advogado de Eduardo em filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) admitted in a GloboNews interview that funds paid by banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, were channeled through a fund linked to the lawyer of his brother, Eduardo Bolsonaro. He sought to mitigate political damage caused by leaked audio revealed by Intercept Brasil, in which he requested money from Vorcaro for the cinematic project.

item.title: Zema vai de cotado a vice a alvo do bolsonarismo após críticas a mensagens de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for the Novo Party, harshly criticized messages from Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro, calling it 'imperdoável' for the senator to request money to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The statement triggered backlash from Bolsonaro supporters, including the ex-president's sons, and effectively ended discussions of a Zema-Bolsonaro ticket, which had been considered to boost votes in Minas Gerais. While Zema’s move had internal Novo Party support, state directories in Paraná and Santa Catarina criticized the video as premature, as he strengthens his independent stance and criticism of Brazil’s institutions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro nega que dinheiro de Vorcaro tenha ido para Eduardo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied that money from Daniel Vorcaro financed Eduardo Bolsonaro's stay in the U.S., stating all funds were used exclusively for the production of the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. He confirmed the fund is managed by Eduardo's lawyer but said his relationship with Vorcaro is solely tied to the film and that he remained silent due to a confidentiality clause in the contract.

item.title: “Flávio apresentou suas explicações”, diz Moro
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) commented on the audio recordings between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating that Flávio had presented his explanations. In a post on X, Moro also declared that 'synonym for corruption in Brazil is the PT', citing scandals such as the Mensalão, Petrolão, and the alleged theft from INSS retirees and pensioners.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro alega sigilo de contrato para não dar detalhes sobre dinheiro de Vorcaro a filme
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed he did not disclose details about the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' by Daniel Vorcaro due to a contractual confidentiality clause. He denied Vorcaro being an executive producer and stated his role was to seek private investors for the film honoring his father, Jair Bolsonaro, while acknowledging he omitted his relationship with the banker prior to Vorcaro's arrest for fraud at Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio diz que dinheiro pago por Vorcaro para filme foi repassado por meio de fundo de advogado de Eduardo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied that funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro intended for the film 'Dark Horse' benefited his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, stating the money was channeled through the Havengate Development Fund LP, managed by Eduardo’s lawyer and based in Texas. He emphasized that the funds were fully used for the film’s production and claimed he had no knowledge of any wrongdoing by Vorcaro, despite public messages showing his request for installment payments to finance the biopic.

item.title: Putin e Dilma se reúnem no Kremlin para discutir banco do Brics
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with former Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff, current head of the New Development Bank (NDB), at the Kremlin in Moscow to discuss the bank’s agenda and cooperation among BRICS member states. Dilma conveyed greetings from Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to Putin, who noted the meeting as an opportunity to assess the bank’s activities and plan future steps under her leadership.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio sobre Master vira pó em menos de 24 horas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense regarding his financial ties to Daniel Vorcaro was deemed weak and disconnected from reality by critics. The allegations presented lack factual basis, as the facts are described as stubborn and undeniable. The defense's argument collapsed within 24 hours in the face of evidence.

item.title: Imprensa internacional repercute áudios de Flávio Bolsonaro para Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: International media outlets have amplified the leak of audio conversations between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, revealing discussions about alleged political and financial negotiations. The recordings, published by Intercept Brasil, include references to potential influence over legislative decisions and conflicts of interest. The case has drawn global attention due to its ties to the Bolsonaro clan and raises concerns about transparency and corruption in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Flávio diz que ocultou relação com Vorcaro por contrato de confidencialidade
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that he concealed his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro due to a confidentiality agreement. He said his only connection with Vorcaro was related to a specific matter, without elaborating. The statement was made in an interview with GloboNews on Thursday, November 14.

item.title: 'Irmão e irmãozinho não significam intimidade', diz Flávio Bolsonaro ao responder sobre mensagens a Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied that using terms like 'brother' and 'little brother' in messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro indicated intimacy, saying it's part of carioca slang. He responded to accusations of requesting money to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about his father, after the release of audio and messages in which he pressed Vorcaro for pending payments, despite Vorcaro having already paid R$61 million for the project.

item.title: Mário Frias dá nova versão sobre dinheiro de Vorcaro depois de contradizer Flávio
item.description: Mario Frias (PL-SP) claims there is no contradiction between his statements and those of Flavio Bolsonaro regarding the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', denying that Daniel Vorcaro or Banco Master contributed funds, while acknowledging that money requested from Vorcaro was transferred via a company linked to him, Entre Investimentos, to a U.S.-based fund. He reiterates that Flavio and Eduardo Bolsonaro have no equity stake in the project, only authorized the use of family image rights, and that all funding was private with no public resources involved.

item.title: Entorno de Flávio aposta que áudio pode ter sido vazado para pressionar Mendonça por delação de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s inner circle believes the leaked audio, in which he asks banker Daniel Vorcaro for money to fund Jair Bolsonaro’s biopic, was leaked to pressure Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça into quickly homologating Vorcaro’s plea deal. The leak allegedly came from individuals close to Vorcaro, aiming to threaten the Bolsonaro family with further damaging disclosures if the deal is not approved.

item.title: Mário Frias recua e diz haver 'diferença de interpretação sobre origem formal' de dinheiro que financiou filme sobre ex-presidente
item.description: Mário Frias walked back his earlier claim that the film 'Dark Horse' received no money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, clarifying that his initial statement referred only to the absence of a formal legal relationship, not actual funding. He acknowledged a 'difference in interpretation regarding the formal origin of the investment,' maintaining there is no material contradiction in his public positions. Audio released by Intercept Brasil shows Flávio Bolsonaro pressuring Vorcaro for overdue payments, confirming the existence of a financing contract for the film.
